name: LightGaussian / CompGS / RDOGS
aliases: Compressing Gaussian Splat Radiance Field Models with Vector Quantization
definition: Compression: prune redundant Gaussians, quantize parameters, learned codebooks.
summary: LightGaussian, CompGS, and RDOGS are 3D Gaussian Splatting compression methods that reduce storage by pruning redundant primitives and quantizing parameters, achieving tenfold size reduction with minimal quality loss.
